verdict.rationale: Dagster documents strong headless scaffolding and configuration: `create-dagster` creates the project, `dg scaffold defs` generates component definitions with a `defs.yaml`, and an official AI skill gives coding agents Dagster patterns. Headless execution of a complete pipeline is only thinly evidenced, through a mention of running dbt subsets via 'UI or APIs' and an MCP server that can 'take actions' in Dagster+. missing for 10: documented CLI/API command to launch or materialize a full pipeline run headlessly, independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the end-to-end flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a coding agent can scaffold, configure, and run a complete pipeline headlessly through the CLI or API

citations.quote: you can scaffold a new project with the create-dagster CLI (recommended)

You can scaffold Dagster Component definitions in your project from the command line with the `dg scaffold defs` command, which will create a new directory inside your `defs/` folder that contains a `defs.yaml` file.
Dagster maintains an AI skill that gives coding agents better context and patterns for building Dagster projects.
The Dagster+ MCP server allows you to access information and take actions in your Dagster+ deployment within an AI session.
Use Dagster's UI or APIs to run subsets of your dbt models, seeds, and snapshots.
